svg.text: Anti-hero: unmasked faces and silhouette, refined
From the faces and silhouettes Orb liked. Top: today (the close-up engine's unmasked face). Below: refined. Neutral, hurt and the signature expression. Right: the silhouette today and two small
options. Working labels, pending Legal review.
Silhouette at fight size: today, then two options (colour, then flat black at 90 px)
Option 1: the long tail and coat blades
The tail runs to the knee and three coat
strips hang from the waist as blades: a
A swept blade of cloth streams back from
one shoulder, low and long, not tall: a
Sharper, longer-lidded eyes and thinner brows; a long lock that falls past the cheek on the open side; the lit slash on
the cheek kept (it is the one mark of him).
Is he colder and sharper in the right way? Which option adds more to the silhouette, the longer tail with coat blades or
